title: 허생전

form.custom: REPAIR THE ATTACHED BEGINNING IMAGE ONLY. Preserve exactly her face, hair, hat, expression, body, outfit, scenery, lighting and full-body camera framing. Keep her own right arm on the image left as it already is, with the right hand gently holding the hat strap. Restore her missing LEFT ARM on the image right: it must visibly run from her left shoulder into the existing robe sleeve, through one elbow, then emerge as a visible wrist and empty hand beside her left upper thigh. Let that left arm hang loosely slightly away from her torso, so its elbow-to-wrist continuity and all five fingers of its natural relaxed hand can be read. The left hand holds nothing. Exactly two shoulders, two arms and two hands. Do not put the new hand inside the sash or on the chest, and do not duplicate the hat-strap hand. This is a localized anatomical repair, not a new outfit or pose design.

prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character (beginning form); keep her.

BOOK: «허생전» by 박지원. comedy and satire · 17세기 효종 무렵의 조선(18세기 작) · 한양 남산 묵적골 → 안성 → 제주 → 빈 섬. Source scope: "『열하일기』 「옥갑야화」에 실린 허생 이야기 전체".

STYLE: 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

Design notes in quotes may be written in Korean; read them as description, never render them as text.

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

GARMENT: whatever the form changes, keep her garment structure: an overlapping robe.

FORM — BEGINNING (발단): "남산골 가난한 선비 — 해진 장부 책장을 겹친 흰 도포, 찢어진 갓, 소매 속의 책". Battle role: scout. This is the question stage of her story.

HOLD BACK: these climactic scenes belong to the open images — keep their creatures and events out of this portrait's setting, even as a distant figure, statue, painting or reflection: "비 새는 남산골 오두막, 쌓인 책 더미와 빈 쌀독"; "안성 장터에 산처럼 쌓인 과일 궤짝과 텅 빈 제사 장터"; "빈 섬 앞바다, 햇빛에 반짝이며 가라앉는 은덩이". An object named in FORM or in her pose stays.

EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the FORM costume, material and palette.

PRESENTATION: a refined, glamorous adult fantasy card illustration — a beautiful, polished face within her FACE structure; a dense, high-detail costume where decorative metal or gold accents (trim, clasps, a breastplate or corset, jewelry) frame the book material without replacing it; warm dramatic backlight with a rim light and strong value contrast.

STANCE (this form): "갓끈을 매만지며 문턱에 비스듬히 서서 곁눈으로 값을 가늠하는 자세" — a poised card pose seen from a slightly low camera, held still and easy to read.

EXPRESSION (BEGINNING): gaze angled down and away, slightly furrowed brow, lips lightly pressed or touched — the mood of this stage. This expression replaces the attached image's; keep only who she is.

OUTPUT: the beginning form of the woman in the attached image, as a new card image. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone, body proportions and palette; change only her costume and bearing, as FORM says. Do not reuse the attached image's outer garment, coat, cape or lining artwork — build the costume FORM describes, keeping only her material and palette. Vertical 2:3 frame (1024×1536), full body with head and feet inside the frame and clear margins, nothing in front of her but what she holds, face toward the camera (front or three-quarter, never a back view). A new card-ready pose is fine.

Chosen settings below override the default stance and camera; her identity and form stay fixed.

Let that left arm hang loosely slightly away from her torso, so its elbow-to-wrist continuity and all five fingers of its natural relaxed hand can be read. The left hand holds nothing. ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border; pages and spines stay unlettered.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands. Her hands keep the same gloves or bare hands as in the attached image.
